name: Real Communism
detailed_description:
Build your own communist utopia! Take control of the means of production to keep your citizens fed, housed, and happy. Grow your city along with its population, and show the world what REAL communism is!

Key Features:

  • Harvesting - Harvest 15 different raw materials such as wood, stone, metal ores, and precious, rare minerals.

  • Building - Use raw materials to build 30 different buildings from the base town hall to housing to production facilities.

  • Crafting - Turn raw materials into 26 different usable goods that can be used by your citizens or sold for gold.

  • Farming - Use the in-depth farming system to make strategic decisions about which of the 20+ crops should be grown.

  • Rule - As the supreme leader, use power for good. Set policies that will advance your city to become the most powerful collective known to man.

  • Citizens - Assign citizens to buildings and watch them go about their daily lives, going from home to work to the pub or the park.

  • Precedural Generation - Take advantage of precedural generation and enjoy many play-throughs. Each map will vary greatly in the types and amount of resources it has, creating a unique experience for each new instance of the game.

  • Happiness - Keep your citizens happy through buildings like the park or the pub. Happy citizens will create new citizens. Unhappy citizens will try to flee.

content_descriptors.notes:
Politics - The player will act as supreme leader of a communist utopia. With that comes the ability to set policy for your city. Some policies, such as abortion, can be hot-button issues in the real world and may be considered mature content.

Prison/Capital Punishment - As punishment for certain actions, citizens may be imprisoned or face capital punishment which, in itself, may be considered mature content.
